title: Synthetic Data Generation Scripts (no README title provided)
summary: A personal Python project with single-table and multi-table synthetic-data pipelines for what appears to be bank transaction data, generating synthetic tables and evaluating their fidelity with quality reports and column-level statistics. It runs SDV's GaussianCopula, CopulaGAN, CTGAN, TVAE and HMA synthesizers directly, alongside the standalone sdmetrics package, to generate and score synthetic data.
